scope: Current active/planned collection from /api/tasks. Inactive final rejections and expired revision holds are outside this current-hold screen. Public PR searches supplement the board review.

nearby_tasks_reviewed.title: Fit a circlip into the groove of a loose shaft with circlip pliers: spread it just enough, seat it, turn it to check
nearby_tasks_reviewed.assessment: The accepted task spreads a circlip radially over a shaft and seats it in a shaft groove. The proposed task separates overlapping spiral turns axially and feeds a closed key hole along the wire until both turns retain the key.

nearby_tasks_reviewed.title: Fit an O-ring onto a hydraulic plug: stretch it over the thread by no more than 50%, seat it square and untwisted
nearby_tasks_reviewed.assessment: The accepted task stretches a closed elastomer O-ring over a plug into a groove. The proposed task opens a split steel spring end and follows its continuous two-turn spiral through a key hole.

nearby_tasks_reviewed.title: Return two keys to an entryway cabinet
nearby_tasks_reviewed.assessment: The held revision hangs already assembled key-and-ring objects on cabinet hooks. The proposed task constructs the key/ring attachment by opening and threading a split ring.

qualification: Research-fit/overlap assessment, not a guarantee of reviewer acceptance or future board availability.
